title: Prefill handoff: Island topology & mini-batcher sync - weekly notes
body:
Meeting: Prefill handoff — Island topology & mini-batcher sync
Date: 2029-04-03 (weekly)
Attendees: Evelyn (owner), Aisha, Marco, Samir, Becky, oncall: Darius (shadow)
Context / goal:
- Transfer design intent and current experiments from Prefill squad to Kernel team for the island-style cache routing prototype.
- Align on mini-batcher API surface that kernel will implement next sprint so prefill can toggle islands with feature flag.
- Surface recent telemetry anomalies and decide immediate mitigations.

Quick summary of progress since last sync:
- Prefill prototype (island topology) has been exercised in shadow traffic for 36h; overall hit rate improved for long-tail prompt families.
- Mini-batcher PoC (local scheduler + coalescer) can reduce per-token kernel entry overhead by ~12% on p95 workloads (bench: 50k sample set).
- Two kernel PRs landed for lightweight kv-lookup latency trimming (PR #3408, PR #3416).

Key discussion points:
1) Island topology routing rules
   - Decision: Use a two-tier routing key: (model-variant, hashed-user-cohort). Cohorts = 256 buckets for initial rollouts.
   - Rationale: small cohort sizes reduce cross-talk for cold long-context requests and simplify eviction budgeting per-island.
   - Action: Marco to author a short RFC describing cohort bucketing vs. sticky keys by 2029-04-07 (linked SRV-8274).

2) Mini-batcher API shape and compatibility
   - Suggested API (kernel-side): accept BatchHint {preferred_deadline_ms, prefer_coalesce: bool, weight_estimate_tokens}. Minimal change to existing handler.
   - Prefill team prefers a feature-flagged header (X-Redwood-MiniBatch: 1) to enable toggles without client changes.
   - Action: Samir to start a compatibility shim in serving-runtime (PR skeleton) and run integration in staging: due 2029-04-10.

3) Eviction and headroom budgeting per island
   - Observed: islands with many medium-length sessions caused eviction churn during tail spikes.
   - Temporary mitigation agreed: reserve 10% headroom per island and fall back to global LRU when island high-water > 80%.
   - Action: Becky to implement the headroom guard and add metrics emitter for island-eviction-rate by 2029-04-09.

4) Telemetry spike on 2029-04-01 night run
   - Root cause hypothesis: ghost-prefill writes triggered double-writes to shadow cache under retry window when kernel GC coincided.
   - Immediate mitigation: add idempotency token check at prefill write path (low-risk).
   - Action: Evelyn to create quick patch and run canary for 48h; target quick-roll by 2029-04-05.

Experiment results (shadow runs)
- Setup: 3-day shadow of island routing on ~2% production traffic, comparison vs baseline routing.
- Hit-rate: +6.8% overall, +14% for top-5 long-tail prompt families.
- Latency: p50 stable, p95 improved by ~8ms where mini-batcher coalesced kernel calls.
- Cost: marginal additional metadata writes (~0.3% token-equivalent); still net-positive under current pricing assumptions.
- Notes: one cohort showed sustained high eviction rate; correlates to a specific tenant workload pattern — follow-up required.

Open blockers / risks
- Kernel scheduler race when mini-batcher attempts to steal a partially-filled slot (seen in lab with synthetic load).
- Observability gaps: need per-island request tracing to map cohort->eviction events end-to-end.
- Rollout policy clarity: what auto-fallback thresholds should trigger deactivation of island routing?

Action items (owners + due dates)
- Marco: RFC for cohort bucketing vs sticky keys — due 2029-04-07.
- Samir: PR skeleton for mini-batcher compatibility shim + integration tests — due 2029-04-10.
- Becky: Headroom guard + island-eviction-rate metric emitter — due 2029-04-09.
- Evelyn: Idempotency token patch for prefill writes + 48h canary — deploy by 2029-04-05.
- Darius (oncall): add per-island tracing hooks to nightly telemetry pipeline (instrumentation only) — monitor results by 2029-04-08.

Decisions recorded
- Proceed with island topology rollout to 5% traffic after headroom guard and idempotency patch are in place.
- Mini-batcher will be behind a feature flag; kernel must accept BatchHint-compatible headers for integration testing.

Notes to self / scribbles
- Consider a lightweight evictor metric: moving-average eviction-per-minute per-island to correlate with kernel GC cycles.
- Keep cohort count configurable (256 default) — reduce to 64 if we observe high cross-island variance.
- Check SRV-8211 for prior notes on sticky-key tradeoffs before final RFC.

Next sync
- Quick async check-in Tues 2029-04-09 (15 min) to confirm headroom guard PR status; full sync 2029-04-10 10:00 for mini-batcher integration demo.

Appendix: Relevant artifacts and quick links
- Mini-batcher PoC notes (internal): /confluence/serving-runtime/mini-batcher-poc
- Benchmark CSV: s3://redwood-ci/bench/mini-batcher/2029-03-28/results.csv
- PRs referenced: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/3421 (mini-batcher shim), https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/3416

Status: draft -> moving to in_review after owner fixes typos and adds RFC link.
